home.heroTitle:
Science-Based Ruminant Nutrition.
From Research to the Farm.
home.heroSubtitle: I work in ruminant nutrition — dairy cow feeding, feed additives, and transition cow management — translating peer-reviewed research into practical, farm-ready decisions.
home.aboutStripTitle: I'm Tolga Akay, an animal nutritionist working at the intersection of research and practice.
home.aboutStripBody: Currently R&D Coordinator and Lab Manager at Global Nutritech, and pursuing graduate studies in animal nutrition. This site is where I publish the technical thinking that doesn't fit in a lab report: rumen physiology, transition cow management, feed evaluation, and the everyday judgment calls that separate a good ration on paper from one that works in the bunk.
home.focusTitle: Ten places where research meets the ration.
home.collabTitle: Have a question that needs more than a quick read?
home.collabBody: I work directly with dairy farms, veterinarians, and feed companies on ration evaluation, transition cow programs, and technical product assessment.
home.collabCta: See how we can work together
home.newsletterBody: Weekly research insights, practical feeding notes, and new technical articles on dairy and ruminant nutrition — straight to your inbox.
